_comment: Daemon config for the Claude Code leg of the coordination e2e. The single custom harness preset is marked default, so an untargeted task frame runs on it; Medulla then injects ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN at the spawn seam. `baseUrl` carries no /v1 suffix because Claude Code appends /v1/messages itself. The top-level [router] is the same endpoint by another route: the capability probe spawns with the daemon's router rather than with a preset (src/sdk/src/daemon/task_loop/probe.rs), so without it the probe would reach the real api.anthropic.com with no credential and report facts only. The port placeholder is substituted by write_harness_config.
